verdicts.reason: A is broken. The 'See the Schedule' button sits on top of the body copy ('Tea and t...') and the fine print, and it runs off the bottom edge. The body text and the fine print are cut off, and the card is jammed against the canvas edges. B has a sensible banner layout: the book cover on the left and a card on the right with a clear headline and CTA. Its flaws: the Inkwell & Lantern logo is tiny and barely readable, the card runs to the top and right edges with no margin, the book floats a little low and is not aligned with the card, and the fine print beside the CTA is very small.
